preflight.notes: Synthetic-token shape/finiteness probe only; does not establish VLA feature, renderer or task performance validity.

E1.retain: 48 final models + lineage, configs, actual counters; operators share fits

GAF.retain: three independently initialized selected+final critics, model/data/config/code identity

LVM_common_token_extraction.reason: Do not invent common pool size. Once N unique frames frozen, feature extraction count=N (or ceil(N/batch) explicit batch calls); FP16 token payload=1048576*N bytes before format overhead; deduplicate before release.

X_VLA_new_SFT_if_analysis_selects.reason: No demonstrated smaller adequate MT50 run;30k is existing finite adaptation recipe, not a proven minimum. First load/2-update technical pilot would require its own job/output and release; B10 does not start it.
X_VLA_new_SFT_if_analysis_selects.estimate_reason: Base3.52GB + mixed-precision model/Adam states and selected/final/resume outputs; must refine after finite pilot, no benchmark claimed

E8_preflight_and_evaluation.reason: Need per-backbone immutable runner/config and analysis per-suite cases before exact finite launch; not silently included in core quote

single_host_wave: One job per explicitly independent wave; lifecycle reserves all8 GPUs and releases only after command exits including failure; no idle-subset holders
joint_wave: Blocked until analysis/A publishes barrier+participant identities; no cross-host computation proposed by this wrapper
timeouts: TERM at timeout_seconds;20s kill grace included in upper wall/GPU job bounds; all8 cards reserved until command exit; estimates are not measured GPU kernel time
